text:
Kai D: RC promote blocked — CI job `ci/cache-populate` failing with cache lease timeouts (4/4). Change window ends in ~50m.

deploy-bot: Promotion held for run 2026-04-25T14:30Z. Failing checks: cache-populate. Logs: https://ci.internal/runs/99100

Renee H: quick glance — lease acquire errors: `ERR_LEASE_BUSY` across multiple pods after the cache indexer bump. Looks like indexer backoff is too aggressive and thrashing leases.

Kai D: options: 1) temp pin indexer to previous image and re-run (fast), 2) add a short-circuit flag to indexer to skip lease contention (small patch), 3) abort and delay cut. We should keep window if possible.

Renee H: I can open a tiny PR to add `--lease-backoff-ms=500` override for promote path; that should reduce thrash. Pin is faster but avoids root cause.

Kai D: prefer quick PR over pin so we don't roll back behavior. If the PR doesn't stabilize within 20m we'll pin.

Renee H: PR created `ci: indexer reduce lease backoff during promote` -> branch `rc/indexer-backoff-1709999012`. Triggering manual promote after merge.

CI_Agent: PR merged by Renee H. Manual promote requested. CI run id 99101 queued.

deploy-bot: CI run 99101 cache-populate: 2/2 passed. Promotion allowed. :white_check_mark:

SRE_Oncall: I'll add a short-term alert on `cache.indexer.lease_conflicts` and hold pager thresholds looser for 15m while we observe canary.

Kai D: drafting release notes: "RC 2026.04.25 — applied temporary indexer lease backoff tweak to mitigate cache lease thrash during promote; follow-up ticket #7120."

Renee H: created ticket #7120 with logs, timing histograms, and proposed fix (lease leader election) for longer-term.

Kai D: cutting RC now. If #7120 surfaces a deeper orchestrator bug we will schedule a patch release outside the change window and revert this temporary flag if needed. Thanks all.
